posts.name: Articos MCP
posts.tagline: See how simulated buyers react, right in your agent
posts.description: Most teams ship, then hope it lands. Articos MCP lets you check first. Right inside Claude or ChatGPT, run your headlines, positioning, or pages past simulated buyers based on your actual customers, and see how they respond before it goes out. Validated against human research from Baymard and Nielsen Norman, it agrees 86% of the time.

posts.name: OpenCode 2.0
posts.tagline: The open source AI coding agent
posts.description: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent. It’s available as a terminal-based interface, desktop app, or web app.

posts.name: Muse Wonder
posts.tagline: Meta’s most capable models for personal agents
posts.description: Muse Wonder is Meta’s new model series for personal and professional agents, with two models: Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full. Active Memory carries your context across conversations, Active Focus keeps working through blockers on hard goals, and it adds domain expertise in law, finance, and health plus stronger coding. Muse Wonder is live on the Meta Model API and Muse Code. Muse Wonder Full is for Muse Code subscribers.

posts.name: Fina Business
posts.tagline: The flexible $20/mo QuickBooks alternative for founders
posts.description: You started a business, not an accounting department. Fina Business gives founders the essentials of business accounting without the complexity of traditional tools. Track business and personal finances your way, automate invoices, accept Stripe payments, manage customers, and get double-entry bookkeeping, P&L, and balance sheets. Start at $20/mo and customize Fina around how your business actually works.

posts.name: Kai
posts.tagline: Autonomous assistant designed to handle meetings and email
posts.description: Kai is an AI executive assistant for solopreneurs, freelancers and startup founders. It works across your email, calendar and tasks: it triages your inbox and drafts replies, schedules around your availability, records and transcribes your meetings, then turns them into summaries and action items. Workflows run in the background, and Kai hands tasks to Claude or ChatGPT with the context of the meeting or email they came from. Web, desktop and mobile. Product Hunt sign-ups get 2x trial credits.

posts.name: MentionBird
posts.tagline: Ahrefs for AI Search
posts.description: We took the top 3 Product Hunt launches and asked ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude the exact questions their buyers ask: “Best browser for Claude Code?” “How do I track agent run costs?” “Best open-source Grok alternative?” Nine answers. Zero mentions. AI sent their buyers elsewhere. That’s how AI search works. It pulls from pages it trusts—listicles, Reddit, comparisons, YouTube. If you’re not there, you’re not in the answer. MentionBird helps you fix that.

posts.name: PostNitro for Agents
posts.tagline: Let your AI agent design and publish social posts
posts.description: Most social APIs let an agent publish text or media it already has. PostNitro lets it design the post too. Connect from Claude or ChatGPT in one click (OAuth, no API key), or use our 35-tool MCP server, CLI or REST API. Your agent turns a topic, article or X thread into an on-brand carousel, image post or animated video, then schedules it to LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Threads, Facebook and Pinterest. Or it hands you an editable draft to finish.

posts.name: MausBot
posts.tagline: Open source Grok Bot: Free, Local
posts.description: Give each bot a job and work with it in a familiar chat interface. MausBot brings your supported AI agents together on your computer, with tools and routines for getting work done. Free and open source under Apache 2.0. Bring your own provider account or API key; provider fees and limits apply.

posts.name: Takes for Mac
posts.tagline: Record talking-head videos. Claude Code does the edit.
posts.description: A free, open-source Mac app for talking-head videos. A teleprompter that follows your voice, one-button recording of camera and screen, and every take in plain folders. Claude Code, on your own Claude plan, cuts the edit, makes the vertical version and drafts the posts. Leave notes on the frame; it turns them into rules and remembers them.

posts.name: Toby
posts.tagline: Realistic mock interviews with an AI hiring manager
posts.description: Paste a job description. Toby researches the company, maps every round and interviews you on a Meet, Teams or Zoom-style call. Then you get a scored debrief and a stronger version of each answer, built only from what you said. Real mode runs it straight through; Coach mode gives a note and a retry. No subscription: 50p a minute on a call. First 5 minutes free.

posts.name: Genchi
posts.tagline: Project delivery predictions, from the people doing the work
posts.description: Genchi shows engineering leaders a prediction of which projects are heading for a missed deadline and which aren't, from the people doing the work. We've rebuilt it from the ground up. Team members vote with one anonymous click in Slack. Leaders see a combined score for every and trend in one portfolio view, so they know where to step in and which teams to leave alone. Genchi works with Jira and Asana. You can see your live portfolio inside Claude, ChatGPT and Grok. Free for teams of up to 10.

posts.name: OpenWhispr for iOS
posts.tagline: 100% open source, free & on device transcription
posts.description: 100% open source, with local models that run on your iPhone or iPad. Transcribe on-device for free, without usage limits, an account or a subscription. Speak your reply, draft an email or capture an idea without uploading your audio for transcription. Download a model once and transcribe offline. Choose optional cloud processing or bring your own API key.

posts.name: vibesmonitor.com
posts.tagline: The ops center for everything you ship
posts.description: Vibesmonitor puts traffic, errors, user feedback and cookie consent for every project you ship on one screen, with an inbox of what needs you first. One script per site. Or ask Claude, Cursor or any MCP agent which project needs you today.

posts.name: Google Fitbit Edge
posts.tagline: Google’s smartest fitness tracker ever with 7-day battery
posts.description: Fitbit Edge is Google’s slim, screen-based fitness tracker for active lifestyles and everyday wear. It has built-in GPS, over 50 workout modes, ECG, skin temperature, and up to seven days of battery per Google. It’s Fitbit’s first repairable tracker, with a replaceable battery. $179.99, pre-order now, on shelves Oct 27. Includes 3 months of Google Health Premium, which is needed for the Health Coach and Health Guardian.

posts.name: Agent Craft
posts.tagline: 100× your social engagement and leads
posts.description: Agent Craft gets your whole team posting from their own social accounts, where posts earn ~7× the engagement of a company page. Each person answers a daily prompt with a 3-minute voice note or video. Craft turns it into native posts for 8 platforms, you approve them in one review queue, and they publish from each person's account. Comments and DMs from likely buyers are qualified and sent to your CRM. $95/month first teammate, $75 each after. 30-day free trial, no card.

posts.name: CLI Manager
posts.tagline: Let one AI agent open and drive your other CLI agents
posts.description: CLI Manager now has an AI Control API. Claude Code, Codex or any script can open sessions in CLI Manager, send prompts, wait, and read the screen - in terminals you can watch. Sessions an AI is driving turn green in the sidebar, the orchestrator gets a crown, and Disconnect AI takes control back anytime. Local only (REST + MCP on 127.0.0.1), off by default. Plus everything from launch #1: Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI in one sidebar. Free, MIT open source, macOS.

posts.name: GotEmail
posts.tagline: Native macOS mail app with one-click sign-in codes and AI
posts.description: GotEmail is a native Mac mail app for people who live in their inbox. Gmail, Outlook, iCloud and any IMAP account in one fast window. Sign-in codes are one click away, AI drafts and summarizes when you ask. Pay once, use on every Mac.

posts.name: Upsolve Row-Level Security
posts.tagline: Data permissions your AI agent can't talk its way past
posts.description: Row-level security enforced server side, before any query runs. Set rules from user and org properties, test them as any user, and deploy one agent to thousands of tenants. The agent never sees the rules, so it can't bypass them.

posts.name: The Drive AI
posts.tagline: The AI agent that does the work on your files
posts.description: Most AI tools can read your files. The Drive AI does the work after reading. One agent across Google Drive, SharePoint, OneDrive, Dropbox, your computer and your NAS. It organizes thousands of files in one prompt, finds duplicates, builds new documents like a closing binder from 20 PDFs, and runs routines on autopilot as new files arrive. It shows the plan first, waits for your OK, and every change can be undone.

posts.name: Servor
posts.tagline: One console to run and monitor all your servers
posts.description: One console for every server you run: web terminal, file editor, scheduled jobs, fleet-wide commands, 150+ install recipes, plus monitoring, phone alerts and status pages. No open port, and every command is signed in your browser.

posts.name: HarnessHive
posts.tagline: AI-Native, Simple & Collaborative Wire Harness Design
posts.description: HarnessHive is the AI-native design ecosystem for wiring harness engineers. Schematic, layout, BOM and a to/scale formboard, all in one live document. With an AI assistant that helps you at every step.

posts.name: Music Dawn
posts.tagline: A recorder for musicians. Every idea sounds finished.
posts.description: Music Dawn is a recorder made for musicians. Record an idea in one tap, hear it with a finished sound right away, and keep every take in one library on all your devices. iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. Free, with optional Pro.

posts.name: OpenFlowKit 2
posts.tagline: Free, open-source diagrams you and your agent edit together
posts.description: A free, open-source diagram canvas: MIT, local-first, no account, in your browser. One canvas, five ways in. Draw it. Write it as code, or paste Mermaid, D2 or Structurizr. Ask any of 10 AI providers, or a local model. Hand it to your coding agent: Claude Code edits the canvas you have open, live, over MCP. Or pull it from a GitHub repo, every arrow citing its file and line. The CLI checks drift in CI, so diagrams keep up with your code.

posts.name: Remocn Studio
posts.tagline: Ship a launch video without opening After Effects
posts.description: A free, open-source macOS app where your own Claude Code, Codex, Copilot or Grok builds your video as a real Remotion project. Watch it change live, click any element to tune it, give notes in chat, export MP4 up to 4K. No timeline. No lock-in

posts.name: Vincentt
posts.tagline: Bring your ideas to life through the camera.
posts.description: Vincentt is the fastest way to build and launch camera experiences on the web. Build with your own coding agent (Claude Code, or Codex) and our open SDK, preview live on your phone, then publish to a link anyone can open. No app store, no headset.

posts.name: Xiryn
posts.tagline: The open-source personal agent that runs on your computer
posts.description: Xiryn is a free, open-source personal agent that does what Muse, Grok Bot and Dots do — on your own computer. Each agent gets its own Linux desktop in Docker, so it browses, researches, codes and fills forms in the background without touching your screen. No account, no telemetry: your data stays on your disk. Any model, local ones too. Control it from anywhere through Telegram — approve payments with one tap or take over its screen from your phone. One command sets it up.

posts.name: Mi Speaks 2.0
posts.tagline: Books and PDFs read aloud by neural voices, on device
posts.description: Mi Speaks reads your books, articles and PDFs aloud. 2.0 adds 28 neural Studio Voices, American and British, generated entirely on your iPhone: nothing is uploaded, and they work in airplane mode. Import a PDF and follow along on the real page with the spoken word lit, jump to any chapter, and prepare a whole document so it plays to the end with the screen locked. Free has no length limit; Premium adds Studio Voices.

posts.name: Scape
posts.tagline: Orchestrate agent fleets with custom tools built on macOS
posts.description: A working example of a loop orchestrator: an AI agent that runs a fleet on a heartbeat, manages its own tickets table as memory, and surfaces bugs from the logs before anyone reports them.

posts.name: AdHelm CLI
posts.tagline: An Open Sourced CLI for Managing Ads
posts.description: AdHelm is a free, Apache-2.0 command-line tool that lets your AI agent connect to your own ad and analytics accounts, report performance, audit them, and recommend changes, entirely on your machine.

posts.name: Benson - Block Discount Extensions
posts.tagline: Block discount extensions from stealing your margin.
posts.description: Benson shows online stores which coupon extensions and AI shopping agents are in their sessions and what they cost. Stores can then hide, cap or replace them, with a holdout behind every change. Detection and agent analytics are free on every plan. New stores get 14 days of the full product with no card needed.

posts.name: Lokutor
posts.tagline: Voice AI on speech foundation models we train ourselves
posts.description: Lokutor is a speech AI company in Madrid. We design and train our own small speech foundation models: Versa (text to speech in 9 languages, incl. Catalan, Galician and Basque), Turno (turn-taking: knows when the caller is done and lets them interrupt) and Psst (noise suppression), with Conv 2.0 (speech recognition) in development. Small models make it fast and affordable: agents answer in about 0.6 s (596 ms median) for about 5¢ a minute, LLM included. Live demo on lokutor.com, no sign-up.

posts.name: Praxis
posts.tagline: Smart reminders that work around your calendar.
posts.description: Praxis takes the mental overhead out of taking supplements. You add your supplements, and Praxis figures out the rest. It reads your calendar and places reminders into gaps in your day, so they arrive when you can act on them. It handles timing and food requirements, detects supplement conflicts, and spaces them out automatically. Instead of constantly figuring out what to take, when to take it, and how everything fits together, you can focus on one thing: Being Consistent.

posts.name: Ruflo Console
posts.tagline: Mission control for your AI agents inside Claude Code
posts.description: Mission control for AI work inside Claude Code. Plan missions, follow workflows and agent activity, inspect logs and results, and track models, tokens and cost. Bring approvals, questions and failures into one view. Let Claude operate the console within permissions you choose, then take back control at any time. Explore memory, security, project decisions and plugins from the same cockpit. Open source, with optional animated themes.

posts.name: GiftPicker
posts.tagline: Gift ideas for the indecisive
posts.description: GiftPicker started as a side project in 2021, when it won #3 Product of Day. Five years later, people are still using and loving it, so we rebuilt it from the ground up! Better matching algorithms, 4x the number of hand-picked gift ideas, and a full redesign. Answer five questions about the person and get a shortlist of genuinely good, hand-picked gifts.

posts.name: Pulse Analytics
posts.tagline: Cookie-free web analytics with uptime, speed & search data
posts.description: Pulse Analytics puts traffic, uptime, performance and Google Search Console data in one dashboard, without cookies. No fingerprinting, no personal data stored, and a script under 3 KB. Built in Belgium, hosted in Switzerland. The dashboard and tracking script are open source (AGPL). Read your numbers through the public API, the CLI, or the MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor. Free for one site up to 5,000 pageviews a month, with every feature on every plan.

posts.name: Blobz
posts.tagline: Playful, deterministic avatars for every user.
posts.description: Blobz generates playful, deterministic SVG avatars from any username, email, or ID. With 4.9 billion+ possible combinations, every user gets a unique, consistent identity without image uploads or storage costs. Integrate Blobz using the free, unlimited React package, ready-to-use shadcn components, or a hosted API with paid plans for high-volume usage. Unique avatars, zero storage, effortless integration.

posts.name: Ontor.ai
posts.tagline: Know when to take break before screen affects your health
posts.description: Spending 7–8 hours a day at a computer can mean tired eyes, a stiff neck, and back pain. Prolonged sitting also adds long-term health risks like type-2 diabetics, cardiovascular diseases, while fatigue can quietly erode focus and performance. Ontor learns how you interact with computer (e.g., typing rhythm, scrolling) to notice changes in your energy and focus, then suggests short breaks and simple exercises to help you finish the day feeling better. Private | On-device | No wearable needed

posts.name: faktry AI Content & Media Workbench
posts.tagline: Ultimate AI-driven content creation platform
posts.description: Stop paying for six tools and juggling five tabs. faktry runs 180+ frontier AI models and 60+ media operations from one account, on one credit balance. Image, video, audio, PDF and 3D. No subscription. No fake "unlimited" promises. No countdown-timer promos hunting you down. Just a workspace for your content creation.

posts.name: Accelerator AI by Lovie.co
posts.tagline: Answer once. Apply to 40 accelerators on your Mac.
posts.description: Accelerator AI is half of FreeTools, a native Mac app. Answer 138 fields about you and your company once, then let the app fill in applications to 40 accelerators, 1,632 form fields between them, in its own browser, on your machine. Nothing is submitted until you press Submit.

posts.name: ApparelAI
posts.tagline: Turn garment photos into studio-grade AI fashion photoshoots
posts.description: ApparelAI turns flat-lay and mannequin photos into studio-grade fashion model shoots in seconds. Preserve real fabric textures, maintain consistent brand model faces, and scale your e-commerce catalog 10x faster for Shopify, Amazon, and global marketplaces.

posts.name: Wolia
posts.tagline: Track good and bad habits in two taps on Apple Watch
posts.description: Most habit apps punish you for one bad day. Wolia doesn't. Set weekly goals for good habits and weekly limits for bad ones — smoking, vaping, drinks, water, workouts — and log each one from your Apple Watch in 1–2 taps. Cut down gradually, not all at once.

posts.name: Clipo - Visual Reference Workspace
posts.tagline: Collect inspiration from anywhere, all in one place.
posts.description: Meet Clipo a visual reference workspace built for designers and creatives. Save images, videos, GIFs, and websites from anywhere(Pinterest, Behance, Dribbble, Instagram, X, and across the web), then organize everything on an infinite canvas. No more scattered screenshots, messy folders, or lost inspiration. With Clipo, you can collect references, explore ideas, and build moodboards in one creative space. Stop collecting. Start creating. Available now for macOS with a 30-day free trial.

posts.name: Influence:Personal Branding For Founders
posts.tagline: A podcast on turning expertise into trust and influence.
posts.description: Building a personal brand is about more than posting content or growing your following. It's about what you want to be known for, how you communicate your expertise & why people should trust your point of view. Influence explores personal branding through practical conversations about positioning, thought leadership, content strategy, storytelling & building credibility online. Each episode tackles a specific problem & offers practical ideas you can apply to your own brand.

posts.name: dood
posts.tagline: joins your meetings and doodles your conversations, live
posts.description: dood is a cure for word vomit. He joins your meetings and doodles your conversation, live, so everyone can follow along. Invite him to brainstorms and team meetings, or classes and coaching on Zoom, Meet or Teams. Make your meeting more memorable by dressing your doodz in custom outfits with your brand colours and logos. After the call, dood sends a mural to recap with your action points.

posts.name: Agent Desk + Session Intelligence
posts.tagline: Find past AI coding sessions and learn what went wrong
posts.description: Find past AI coding work and learn what to change next. Agent Desk brings sessions from Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Kiro and Antigravity into one local macOS app, with rules, skills and hooks in a separate harness view. Session Intelligence analyzes extracted transcripts for missing context, repeated corrections, outcomes and wasted effort. Two separate MIT-licensed tools. Build Agent Desk from source; run analysis with your own LLM.

posts.name: PropertyPixel
posts.tagline: Your next listing. Shown in its best light.
posts.description: AI photo editing for real estate professionals. Fix dark rooms, declutter, straighten and reframe, swap grey skies, go day to dusk or virtually stage empty rooms in about a minute. Select any object in the room to remove, recolor or replace it. Turn the photos into a listing video or embeddable 3D tour. Works with ChatGPT and Claude, or through our API. Pay as you go, no subscription required. Enhance your first 5 photos free.

posts.name: Email HTML Editor by Reloop
posts.tagline: Visual editor for email HTML. Free, no signup.
posts.description: Edit email templates visually. Copy production-ready HTML. Free, no account, runs in your browser. Start from 30 templates, type on the canvas, add {{variables}}, restyle any block, or flip to the code and edit HTML directly.

posts.name: Drifty for Windows
posts.tagline: Private AI time tracker that learns how you work
posts.description: Drifty is a private AI time tracker that learns how you work. It tracks your day automatically, with no timers or manual entries, and separates focus from distraction based on context. The more you use it, the better it knows you, as your work profile, what you did before and after each activity, and every correction you make shape how it reads your day. Local mode is completely free, your data never leaves your device, and no screenshots or recordings are ever stored.

posts.name: Vendure
posts.tagline: Self-serve plans for complex B2B, Vendure Cloud included
posts.description: Vendure plans are live, and for the first time you can buy Vendure without talking to us. Starter (€199/mo), Growth (€599/mo) and Scale (€2,499/mo) are self-serve: bought on a card, flat prices, no fee on your sales. Each plan adds B2B capability: company accounts, quotes, account hierarchies, contract pricing and order approvals. Vendure Cloud comes with every paid plan at no extra cost when it ships in Q1 2027. Plus a rebuilt vendure.io with platform comparisons and migration guides.

posts.name: MasjidFlow
posts.tagline: Modern mosque management, all in one place.
posts.description: MasjidFlow helps mosque committees and administrators manage members, donations, expenses, funds, and reports in one organized workspace. Replace scattered records and manual administrative work with a modern, structured platform built to simplify mosque operations and support better financial record-keeping.

posts.name: Files Magic AI File Rename & Organizer
posts.tagline: Organize and Rename files with AI Locally or Cloud on mac
posts.description: Files Magic AI is a Mac app that sorts messy folders with AI and renames files with AI both locally via Apple Intelligence (Slow) and also via cloud ( Fast ).Pick a template, preview the folders it will create, edit them, then organize in one click. Magic Rename gives files clean names from their content, using Cloud AI, offline rules, or batch rules. Every rename can be undone with Revert to Original. It finds duplicates, unwanted files. Onetime lifetime license Offer.

posts.name: GitComet 0.3.0
posts.tagline: Fastest Open Source
posts.description: GitComet is a free, open source, local-first Git GUI built for large repositories. Browse huge histories, stage individual lines, and resolve merges on Linux, macOS, and Windows.

posts.name: Fix Singapore GP
posts.tagline: Redesign the Singapore GP. Analyse it. Drive it in 3D.
posts.description: Redesign the Singapore GP circuit and test your ideas in 3D. Remix Marina Bay, create alternative layouts, compare track analytics and overtaking potential, then share your designs with the F1 community. Inspired by the debate around overtaking at the Singapore Grand Prix, FixSingaporeGP is an open-source playground for fans to experiment with better racing layouts. Can you design a better circuit?

posts.name: FrameRoll
posts.tagline: Design a carousel as one picture, post it as frames
posts.description: FrameRoll lets you design a whole carousel on one continuous canvas, with frame seams always visible. Preview every frame, then export them all in posting order as JPEG, PNG or TIFF. No account, no tracking, works offline. Free to start.

posts.name: Cozy
posts.tagline: A private journal that stays yours
posts.description: Cozy keeps your journal on your own device, as your own files you can open with anything. There's no Cozy server, and nothing is fed to AI.

posts.name: BasicOps
posts.tagline: The workplace where humans and AI agents work as one team.
posts.description: BasicOps is a workplace for projects, tasks, communication, and files, where AI agents get a seat, a role, and permissions and work alongside your team. Bring agents from any builder, on any model, with a person in control. Working with agents should be as easy and familiar as working with your human team members. You can chat like Slack, manage tasks and projects like Asana, monitor progress and get reports all in one place.

posts.name: HomeoNetix
posts.tagline: Homeopathy clinic software with case taking and AI
posts.description: HomeoNetix helps homeopathic doctors take structured cases, repertorise symptoms, track follow-ups and manage clinic operations in one workspace, with AI-assisted case analysis.

posts.name: AIComics
posts.tagline: Turn any story into a comic with AI
posts.description: AIComics turns your story into finished comic pages. Write or paste a story and it drafts the chapter script, designs a consistent cast and draws every panel, complete with layouts, speech bubbles and sound effects. Then edit text and bubbles, regenerate any page, export, or publish to the community Gallery. 5 art styles in color or B&W. Free to start with 500 credits, packs from $0.99, no subscription, and you own what you make.

posts.name: Ollin
posts.tagline: Plan it. Live it. Relive it. One app for the whole trip
posts.description: Describe a trip in one sentence and get a real day-by-day plan. Plan it with everyone coming, book through partners with no Ollin fee, follow it on the ground with live flight status and reminders, then keep it as a recap. Free to start on iPhone, Android and the web.

posts.name: Kivi UI
posts.tagline: Build UIs with components, blocks, shaders & AI tools.
posts.description: A zero-compromise React component library built for developers who care about craft. Accessible, dark-mode-first, and obsessively detailed.

posts.name: rag_control
posts.tagline: Runtime governance and policy controls for RAG systems
posts.description: A Python control layer for governing RAG applications at runtime. Define generation policies, filter retrieval by document metadata and user context, apply organization-level rules, and inspect decisions with audit logs, traces, and metrics. Works with your existing LLM and vector-store adapters. Built by RetrievalLabs, which is making enterprise software development end-to-end AI-native.

posts.name: Pitch Video
posts.tagline: Record your pitch once. Your agent edits the demo video.
posts.description: Pitch Video is an open-source agent skill that turns a video of you talking into a finished product demo. Record yourself reading your pitch once. Claude Code films your app, cuts every shot to the exact words that introduce it, trims pauses, and adds captions, a face bubble, an explainer animation, sound effects and music. A built-in check measures lip sync, audio drift and loudness before you get the file. Free, MIT, runs locally.

posts.name: TrailMind
posts.tagline: AI running coach that adapts after every run
posts.description: TrailMind is a personal running coach powered by AI. Tell it about an upcoming race and it builds a training plan up to race day — then adjusts it week by week based on how your runs actually go. After every run, the coach analyzes pace, consistency, and elevation, and explains what it means. Full GPS tracking, suggested loop routes, and a no-ads social feed to share runs with friends. Free to start. TrailMind+ unlocks unlimited AI plans and analysis. Built solo, iOS only for now.

posts.name: Pasteparrot
posts.tagline: Translate where you type. Stay in your flow.
posts.description: Write in your language and translate into 17 languages without leaving your Mac app. Select text, preview the translation, then replace it. Turn rough ideas into clear AI prompts, too. Supports terminal drafts with optional local Zsh integration.

posts.name: Matilda
posts.tagline: Auto-sync your iMessage lead conversations to your CRM
posts.description: Matilda syncs your iMessage lead conversations to your CRM automatically. Connect Follow Up Boss, Lofty and Cloze. Matilda will map the conversation into your CRM so you never have to manually enter anything ever again.

posts.name: Bellman
posts.tagline: Rooms where AI agents from any tool work together
posts.description: Bellman gives AI agents a shared room. Start one from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client and share the code. Every agent that joins gets the room's brief, its messages and a shared canvas. Peer content stays untrusted, and actions need your approval.

posts.name: DropText
posts.tagline: Share text or code with a link. Pro free until 2027
posts.description: Paste text or code, get a link and a QR code. No signup, no ads. Viewers see edits live, links expire on their own, and one-time links can't be burned by chat previews. Pro adds passwords, optional in-browser encryption and file uploads, free until 31 Dec 2026.

posts.name: Kosh
posts.tagline: Help your family find insurance and take the next step
posts.description: Kosh keeps your insurance details, document locations and claim contacts together. Share access with family so they can find your policies, ask questions and get AI guidance on what to do next.

posts.name: Formalini V2
posts.tagline: Developer Tools. Business. Document to Data. Earn with Us
posts.description: Formalini is evolving beyond AI document extraction into a complete automation and developer platform. What's new? Browser-based DevOps, QA tools for accessibility audits, Playwright test generation, API testing and visual regression, alongside AI-powered document processing, reusable workflows and upcoming industry-specific Blueprints. One platform where businesses automate repetitive work and developers build, integrate and monetize solutions without juggling multiple tools. And a way to earn.

posts.name: Cadabra AI
posts.tagline: Turn one sentence into an edited AI film
posts.description: Write one sentence and Cadabra AI turns it into an edited film: shots, voice-over, music and captions, cut together. The Genie shows you the plan and the exact price before anything runs, and failed generations are refunded automatically. 30+ leading video, image, voice and music engines behind one credit balance, no subscription. Works on the web and inside Claude and ChatGPT. 10 free credits to start.

posts.name: Water Shaker 3D: Stress Relief
posts.tagline: Shake off stress with swirling water and soothing sounds
posts.description: Turn your phone into a soothing 3D water toy. Tilt and shake to watch realistic water ripple and objects tumble and swirl, accompanied by gentle water sounds. Mix rubber ducks, gems, marbles, and more, choose how many appear, and customize the water color and background. Optional relaxing music and a glowing night mode help you pause and unwind. Available for iPhone and Android.

posts.name: HomeRank
posts.tagline: Decide on the right home for you
posts.description: HomeRank helps you decide which home is your best fit. Rank the homes you’re considering on what you care about, from the kitchen to the commute, right from your phone as you tour. Then see which one comes out on top, and why. Free, no account needed.

posts.name: Swiftly
posts.tagline: Turn ideas and footage into publish-ready videos with AI
posts.description: Swiftly is a conversation-first AI video creative partner. Start with an idea, photos, clips, product shots or references; shape the story, scenes, captions and style through chat, then review and export a publish-ready video.

posts.name: Clarity Audit
posts.tagline: Find UX friction before your visitors leave
posts.description: AI-powered UX diagnostic that scans any website and predicts what your first visitor will do — before they bounce. Clarity score, heatmap, competitor comparison, and ready-to-paste fix prompts. No login. 60 seconds. 661 sites scanned, average score 42/100.

posts.name: TryAgainText + FlirtFix
posts.tagline: Better dating app replies on web and Android
posts.description: Turn a dating app chat into three reply ideas that fit the conversation. Paste text or upload a screenshot, choose the situation, and edit the suggestion that sounds like you. TryAgainText works in your browser with two free generations and no account needed. FlirtFix brings the same idea to Android, with personalized openers from dating profiles, chat replies, saved conversations, and a blur tool for hiding sensitive parts of screenshots.

posts.name: CricArcade
posts.tagline: Free cricket strategy games built on 8700+ real matches
posts.description: CricArcade is a free, browser-based cricket gaming platform built on over 8,700 real Test, ODI and IPL matches, with 10,000+ users in its first two months. Play Tests, ODIs and T20s, run an IPL dynasty from any season since 2008 with real auctions, take a nation through a World Cup cycle, or challenge a friend head to head. Player ratings come from what they actually did on the field, so matches play out like real cricket. Runs in your browser, no download.

posts.name: Devbroom
posts.tagline: Clean up after your AI coding agents
posts.description: AI coding tools move fast. The clutter they leave behind doesn't. DevBroom helps Mac developers find leftover files from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and other coding agents. See what's taking up space, understand what you're removing, and review everything before it goes to the Trash. No blind cleanup. No terminal commands. Just a cleaner development environment.

posts.name: PomoSauna
posts.tagline: A Pomodoro timer in a sauna. Nothing to keep up with.
posts.description: A monk sits in a sauna. Start a session and the room fills with steam while a ring holds the time; when it ends, a bell opens the waterfall and he cools beneath it. A Live Activity keeps time on the Lock Screen. No account, no streaks, no stats, no ads. Free.

posts.name: Greenkeep
posts.tagline: Grow the garden. Command the swarm.
posts.description: Greenkeep is lane defence with a permanent garden — lost raids steal your harvest, not the lawn you built. Scout a rival base, stack insect lanes, and break it while its keeper sleeps. Defend offline with plants that stay put. Climb Gold Cup seasons, fight 24-hour team wars, and unlock the Garden Codex. Play free in the browser or on Android.

posts.name: Rewatch
posts.tagline: Never rewatch a YouTube video again
posts.description: I got tired of rewatching the same YouTube videos just to find the useful part. Rewatch turns any YouTube link into AI notes: one-line TL;DW, key points, action items, and chapters that jump to the exact moment. It becomes your private, searchable knowledge library. Free forever for up to 100 videos (no card needed). Pro is $3.99/mo or $29.99/yr for unlimited videos + chat, mind maps, graph view, playlist import, and more. Try it free → rewatch.club

posts.name: Flick
posts.tagline: Every window. One flick.
posts.description: Flick is a fast, searchable window switcher for Mac. Hold ⌥ and tap Tab to jump to any window on any Space, or type to find it. Private and keyboard-first.

posts.name: Rewatch
posts.tagline: Never rewatch a YouTube video again
posts.description: I got tired of rewatching the same YouTube videos just to find the useful part. Rewatch turns any YouTube link into AI notes: one-line TL;DW, key points, action items, and chapters that jump to the exact moment. It becomes your private, searchable knowledge library. Free forever for up to 100 videos (no card needed). Pro is $3.99/mo or $29.99/yr for unlimited videos + chat, mind maps, graph view, playlist import, and more. Try it free → rewatch.club

posts.name: Realust
posts.tagline: The nutrition label for North Texas cities
posts.description: Moving to Dallas? Realust scores all 84 cities in Collin, Dallas, Denton and Rockwall counties on 288 data points each: schools, safety, home prices, commute, growth and more. Every city is scored the same way, from the same sources. Compare cities side by side, re-rank them with your own priorities, or take an 8-question quiz to find your match. Built by a local former architect who thinks choosing a city deserves better data than choosing a kitchen. Free to use.

posts.name: JD Resume Review by AllthingsPM
posts.tagline: See exactly where your PM resume falls short for one job
posts.description: Upload your resume, pick or paste a product manager job description, and get a match score plus the gaps that matter: missing signals, weak bullets and skills the role asks for that your resume never shows. Comes with concrete rewrites, not just critique. One free review a day.

posts.name: AcceptDeck
posts.tagline: Client sign-off for Jira, without giving clients Jira access
posts.description: AcceptDeck makes client approvals simpler for teams using Jira. Share a review link with clients, collect approvals or change requests, and keep decisions tracked in Jira — without asking clients to navigate Jira themselves. Built for agencies, consultancies, and teams delivering work to clients.

posts.name: sCycle
posts.tagline: A period tracker with an otter or a fox in your corner
posts.description: sCycle is a period tracker with a companion. Pick Mo the otter or Juno the fox: they know your cycle day, explain your phase and remember what helped last month. Free, no account, no ads, and your cycle stays on your phone.

posts.name: POOP LAUNCHER
posts.tagline: Aim your butt. Blast the poop. Knock ’em all away.
posts.description: A silly, satisfying physics shooter that runs right in your browser. Aim a butt cannon, fire normal, loose, or giant poop, and knock a stack of poop off the table. Chain reactions, combo callouts, and EN/JP support. No download, no sign-up.

posts.name: PLens
posts.tagline: Scan foreign product labels and shop with confidence
posts.description: PLens helps travelers, expats, and international shoppers understand unfamiliar packaged products. Scan a label or barcode to get a clear product name, translated details, ingredients, dietary context, and practical buying facts in your language.

posts.name: Narrow Front
posts.tagline: One-thumb WWII strategy you can play offline
posts.description: A portrait WWII strategy game for iPhone, iPad and Android. Send infantry into farmhouses while tanks cover the road. Fight ten story missions from Normandy to the Rhine, or play offline skirmishes. Free to download.

posts.name: SiliconDevKit
posts.tagline: Build native Mac apps with AI
posts.description: Building a Mac app or game usually means learning Swift, setting up Xcode, and other tedious taks. SiliconDevKit lets you skip all that. Describe what you want in plain English and get a native app or game. Keep chatting to improve it, build from 70+ templates, or push the source to GitHub.

posts.name: hidane
posts.tagline: A Firestore emulator without Java, in one Rust binary
posts.description: hidane replaces the official Cloud Firestore emulator with a single Rust binary: no JDK, a 5.5 ms start, 7.4 MiB idle. It speaks gRPC, REST and WebChannel, enforces Security Rules, and runs under firebase-tools, where Firestore-triggered Cloud Functions fire as with the official emulator (new in v0.4). Parity is measured, not claimed: hidane's tests replay 20,224 answers recorded from the official emulator, and firebase-js-sdk's own browser suite passes.

posts.name: Seekter
posts.tagline: An open-source job-search agent that runs in Claude Code.
posts.description: Seekter is an open-source AI agent for job search, built on Claude Code. Every day it searches job sources, filters postings against your own rules (location, visa, sectors, seniority, language) and fills application forms in your own Chrome. It never guesses an answer, never touches a CAPTCHA or a password, and never fills LinkedIn Easy Apply. Every application and every skip is kept as a markdown file on your computer. Free and MIT-licensed; running it needs a Claude plan.

posts.name: Pip Leap
posts.tagline: Leap, stomp and shoot in the sugary hills of Gummy land
posts.description: Pip Leap — leap, stomp and shoot stars at the Gummy Gang across 100 levels in the sugary hills of Gummy land. A platformer game with hidden bonuses.

posts.name: GetFaceSwap
posts.tagline: Free AI face swap for photos, GIFs and videos
posts.description: Swap faces in photos, reaction GIFs and short videos right in your browser. Free, with no sign-up. What's different: in group GIFs and videos you choose exactly who changes, giving each person their own replacement face while everyone else stays untouched. Start from ready-made templates (yearbook, 80s, business, sports, memes) or upload your own scene, trim videos in-app, and download in seconds.

posts.name: SankeyFlow
posts.tagline: The Sankey diagram maker built for the Mac
posts.description: Write your flows as text, build them in a visual list, or paste a spreadsheet, and get a Sankey diagram. Show leftovers as Remainder boxes, then export PNG, PDF, or SVG. A native Mac app with no account; nothing leaves your Mac. $6.99.

posts.name: JevStation
posts.tagline: Typed decisions for your code: probabilities, not prose
posts.description: JevStation gives your code decisions instead of text. Send a ticket, review, tool call or model answer, ask up to 12 Choice, Score or Noul questions, and get typed answers with probabilities and a confidence value, nothing to parse. Run Jev (System One) plus Cloudflare Clef, Perplexity Decider, OpenAI Luna Decisions and Microsoft-Decision-1 on one key via playground, REST API, MCP server or batch spreadsheets. Try it free, no sign-up.

posts.name: Planitude
posts.tagline: AI builds your Gantt and flags deadline risks
posts.description: Turn a project idea into a realistic schedule with Planitude. AI creates a complete Gantt from a short description, suggesting tasks, durations, dependencies and milestones. A real scheduling engine recalculates dates and critical paths as plans change; Monte Carlo simulations estimate your odds of meeting deadlines. Collaborate for free, import Microsoft Project files, and connect Jira, Azure DevOps, Teams, Slack, ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.

posts.name: Simmerset
posts.tagline: Plan the week's dinners and get one grocery list by aisle
posts.description: Simmerset plans a week of dinners and writes one grocery list, sorted by aisle. Say who's eating, what they must never eat and how long a weeknight is, and you see three dinners before you sign up. An allergy takes a recipe out of every plan, and missing allergen data counts as containing it. Each line on the list shows which dinners need it. Use it on iPhone, Android or the web, free with no time limit. Leaving Mealime before October 21? Type the dinners you cooked there to find close matches.

posts.name: Human Oracle
posts.tagline: Give your overthinking to a stranger
posts.description: Break a small overthinking loop with one anonymous human decision. Answer a stranger's YES/NO question, then send yours into the world. No profiles, context, advice, or algorithm — just another human's instinct and your honest reaction.

posts.name: Folyo
posts.tagline: AI-powered invoice and expense management
posts.description: Folyo automatically finds invoices and receipts in your email, downloads and organizes them, tracks expenses, analyzes spending and helps you manage everything with AI. Connect Gmail, Outlook or IMAP and keep all your financial documents in one organized workspace.
